title: Coleman-Oort conjecture: eventual special-subvariety exclusion
exact_target: In sufficiently large genus, are positive-dimensional special subvarieties excluded from the Torelli locus whenever they contain smooth Jacobians generically?

sources.citation: Diego Conti, Alessandro Ghigi and Roberto Pignatelli, Some evidence for the Coleman-Oort conjecture, arXiv2102.12349v2.
